ezekiel.5.p1.b1.text: “As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword, use it as a barber’s razor, and shave your head and beard. Then take a set of scales and divide the hair.

ezekiel.5.p1.b2.text: When the days of the siege have ended, you are to burn up a third of the hair inside the city;

ezekiel.5.p1.b3.text: you are also to take a third and slash it with the sword all around the city;

ezekiel.5.p1.b4.text: and you are to scatter a third to the wind. For I will unleash a sword behind them.

ezekiel.5.p1.b5.text: But you are to take a few strands of hair and secure them in the folds of your garment. Again, take a few of these, throw them into the fire, and burn them. From there a fire will spread to the whole house of Israel.

ezekiel.5.p2.b1.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.

ezekiel.5.p2.b2.text: But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes worse than the countries around her. …

ezekiel.5.p2.b3.text: A third of your people will die by plague or be consumed by famine within you,

ezekiel.5.p2.b4.text: a third will fall by the sword outside your walls,

ezekiel.5.p2.b5.text: and a third I will scatter to every wind and unleash a sword behind them.

ezekiel.5.p2.b6.text: So you will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror to the nations around you, … I, the LORD, have spoken.
